about: The ports each Veeam role listens on, from the ports pages of the Veeam Backup & Replication 12 and 13 guides, and the ports a backup server's services hold on the loopback address only, read on a version 13 backup server (the guides list none). The Local Port Checker offers each role as a preset: the ports a machine in that role should hold. 'versions' lists the Veeam Backup & Replication versions (12, 13) whose guide lists the entry; an entry without it applies to both, and with no version chosen an entry of one version is shown as VBR 12 only or VBR 13 only. 'from' is who connects; 'optional' marks a port the guide calls optional or needs only in some setups; 'dynamic' marks a range checked as one row, held only while a job or a failover uses it; 'programs' names the program that holds it, for the firewall verdict while none of it is held (Windows' Veeam rules allow a program on any port); 'loopback' marks a port the service holds on the loopback address only; 'any_program' marks a range any program may hold, such as dynamic RPC, whose holders are not told apart from the data mover's; 'platform' limits an entry to Windows or Linux machines in that role.
